B.text: A signed consent form does not automatically amount to informed consent, so this is incorrect.

C.text: State laws vary, so consent requirements are not identical everywhere.

D.text: Providers are encouraged to learn their own state's informed consent laws and regulations, so written consent does not replace that knowledge.

explanation.text: AAPD recommends written consent before treatment starts, despite differences among states, because it can lower liability from miscommunication.
Written consent does not replace knowing state law or having a true informed consent process.
